analysis.campaignTitle: Monaco ECO Gaveæsker: Tre nye farver
analysis.primaryGoal: Promote new color options for Monaco ECO gift boxes and drive shop interest.
analysis.audience: B2B customers and brand retailers seeking sustainable gift packaging.

layoutPatterns: Hero image of product in use
visualStyle.imageStyle: Polished studio photography with soft, neutral backgrounds and lifestyle context

copyStyle.urgency: Mild; focused on product novelty, not limited-time

reusablePatterns: Announce new product options with a hero image and focused headline
Use checkpoints or checkmark lists to convey key product strengths
Grid-style display of product variants with clear CTAs under each
Visual storytelling with lifestyle + studio shots
Prominent, color-blocked CTAs recurring through the email
Highlight ease or simplicity (e.g. low MOQ, free branding) via icon/accent section
risks: Heavy reliance on product images—could underperform in text-only or dark mode views
Limited urgency could reduce immediate response
Absence of explicit pricing/offer may limit conversions

confidence.notes: All visible text, buttons, and product names read with high clarity; no subject line or preheader visible.
